test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

‘M & N’ means ‘M is the wife of N’,

‘M @ N’ means ‘M is the brother of N’,

‘M $ N’ means ‘M is the daughter of N’,

‘M # N’ means ‘M is the son of N’.

Based on the above, how is Q related to N if ‘N # M @ O $ P & Q’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png]

Given: N # M @ O $ P & Q 

N # M → N is the son of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f9acab45fe9c2195ee6ba47fd7e97f2a4c9b7eb44e345d114bc852368a6e100.png] 

M @ O → M is the brother of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08054ab2d2ef276ad254f90d5c43cd790e142d4b4688f33c5fdd7a80ae710555.png] 

O $ P → O is the daughter of P.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75cd897820a40ae3c7b36cbb4d9fc9ff2122ab9c2db75e5851fb7b98eb86231c.png] 

P & Q → P is the wife of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dca1687b9f46d807369b8e5f8615cc2f05e773512135ff5606e1a3a74046d8e2.png] 

Here, Q is the paternal grandfather or father's father of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
